data.name: Fractal Soul
data.detailed_description:
Weaponize your infinite skill tree to evolve from a fragile wanderer into a god-like entity.

Mutate through various races, master unique job titles, and fundamentally change how your skill tree expands.

Slay enemies and annihilate bosses to reap balance-defying items, find forgotten, overpowered weaponry, and discover all kinds of magic like spells and curses to crush anything standing in your way.

Your skill tree has no hard cap and never stops branching. Keep unlocking new branches, traits, and upgrades as you play, ensuring your build can always go deeper. Mix offensive, defensive, utility, magic, and way more to create broken combos and entirely unique playstyles.

Key Features

  • Limitless Progression: An uncapped, ever-expanding skill tree continuously generates new paths.

  • Total Evolution: Evolve through distinct races and master specialized jobs.

  • Unrestricted Builds: Combine conflicting stats and abilities to create wildly overpowered character builds.

  • Ancient Arsenal: Find and master, weapons, items and spells to annihilate enemies and bosses that stand in your way.

  • Endless possibilities: Adapt to what you find, pivot your strategy, and turn risky decisions into game-changing power spikes.

  • Global Hardcore Leaderboards: Experience a single-player journey with optional asynchronous competition.
    Strive for global dominance in Permadeath mode: if you die, your legacy is immortalized on the leaderboards, and your character seamlessly drops into Normal mode so your power fantasy continues.

In Fractal Soul, progression is the game. Every evolution unlocks new potential, every branch opens another possibility, and every "what if?" can become your next overpowered build.

Grow forever. Experiment endlessly. Break the game in your own way.

‎
Capsule Art by: @Abs0lut3Era
